title: Cartouche I-4
medium: Paper collaged to cloth in three parts, suspended on aluminium tubes with twine threaded through brass eyelets

events.who: Kenneth Tyler, Lindsay Green and Steve Reeves
events.n: made in collaboration with Kenneth Tyler, Lindsay Green and Steve Reeves
events.q: It was the first time he had worked in this medium and the pieces were made in collaboration with Kenneth Tyler, Lindsay Green and Steve Reeves at the Tyler Graphics paper mill in Bedford, New York.
